Use case: game UI reward collectible icon for a children's app (ages 3-4) — a magical "star piece" kids collect.
Subject: ONE five-pointed star, perfectly upright (one point straight up), symmetrical, seen straight on, centred, filling about 86% of the square canvas.
Style: MINIMAL and clean, like a modern app icon. Slightly rounded points. Soft pastel gradient from warm white-gold at the centre to lavender and sky blue at the tips.
It must look like it is glowing with soft light from within: a bright luminous core fading gently toward the edges, a soft inner glow along the edges. Smooth simple shapes only — NO busy facets, NO many shards, NO glitter noise, no texture. At most one or two tiny twinkle sparkles.
No face, no text, no frame, no extra objects. TRUE transparent background, no drop shadow, no halo outside the star (the app adds the outer glow).
